question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Empty
solution:
The correct answer is: **Vacant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Empty"** means containing nothing; not filled or occupied. (खाली)

 
 
• **Example:** The glass was empty after he drank all the water.
 
 
 
• **"Vacant"** refers to something that is not filled, used, or occupied; devoid of contents or occupants. (रिक्त)
 
 
• **Example:** The hotel had several vacant rooms available for booking.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the most appropriate synonym for "Empty" is **"Vacant."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Vacant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Common** (सामान्य): Occurring, found, or done often; widespread.

 
 
• **Example:** It is common to see people enjoying street food in this city.
 
 
 
• **Busy** (व्यस्त): Engaged in activity; not free or idle.
 
 
• **Example:** She was too busy to attend the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Dear** (प्रिय): Loved or valued highly; precious.
 
 
• **Example:** My grandmother is very dear to me.
